scenario: Rule-firing order is spec-defined, NOT implementation-defined, per LTES.12.9 — the terminal ordinal, which is source position ([LDET.5.4]). The clause's force is its negative half: an order falling out of when matches happened to complete would depend on propagation internals, which is precisely what it forbids. So the compile-side pin is that the TerminalNode sequence is the SOURCE sequence — `zebra` before `alpha`, so a lowering that sorted by name would fail — and that nothing else rides the artefact to order rules, field 9 (salience) being reserved. Sibling to LDET.10.7.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule zebra:
    Trig
->
    log info "zebra"

rule alpha:
    Trig
->
    log info "alpha"
